cost_estimate: Negligible: one pass over training interactions and a 12-token suffix vocabulary; no additional embedding model or quantizer training. Sequence-model cost is effectively unchanged.
falsifiable_hypothesis: The suffix improves held-out next-item ranking over baseline, especially for repeat-consuming users and within frequency-matched item groups; measure overall Recall@K/NDCG@K and those predeclared slices. It is not worth keeping if frequency-matched performance does not improve, indicating the suffix only duplicates popularity.
key_change: Append a discretized demand-shape suffix computed from training interactions, separating repeat/revisit propensity from raw item frequency so the generative model can condition on distinct usage regimes without changing item embeddings.
motivation: Content-near items can have very different roles in user activity: some are repeatedly revisited while others are typically one-off discoveries. A content-only SID can therefore fail to distinguish items whose consumption patterns call for different continuation predictions.
novelty: This adds a low-cardinality behavioral descriptor derived from the shape of training-only item usage, not a transition/adjacency objective, graph embedding, or popularity-weighted codebook loss; the existing content SID remains unchanged.
risks: Repeat propensity is noisy for infrequent items, and per-frequency-bin quantiles may be unstable; user/item leakage can arise if boundaries accidentally use validation or test interactions. The appended behavior may be nonstationary or redundant with sequence context and could worsen cold-item generalization.

specification.text: Using training sequences only, for each item i compute f_i=count of occurrences, u_i=count of distinct training users, and r_i=(number of users with >=2 occurrences of i)/(u_i+1). Compute p_i=log(1+f_i/u_i) (set to 0 if u_i=0). Within each training-only frequency decile, quantile-bin r_i into 3 bins; independently quantile-bin p_i into 2 bins. Append suffix d_i=6*b_r+b_p to the baseline SID. Fit decile boundaries and quantiles on training items/interactions only; freeze them for validation/test. Evaluate against the unmodified baseline using the same sequence split and model settings.

title: Add a compact train-only demand-shape suffix
